stated.scope: Every Solana token of the classes of UniverseCategory that a read below names and a rule or a verdict of solana.verdicts.json classifies. A verdict is a decision with its source; this list decides nothing a plan may hold (DA5): the shelf is decided under UNIVERSE.
stated.enumeration: In the prompt's order (5.2): Jupiter's verified list, live, every tag kept (3933 tokens); the reserves of risk_lending_pools, their mints and debt mints (41 rows); the research note docs/vault/research/yield-shelf/solana.md (25 full addresses in it) and its shelf fixture packages/engine/src/personal/fixtures/shelves/solana-yield.json (19 rows); DefiLlama's stablecoins and its protocols on Solana in the RWA and yield categories, as names only (73 and 56); the issuers' pages of scripts/risk/assets/solana.issuer-mints.json (48 mints). Also read: the tracked stock list, the structurer's registry, the Scope table and the launch-shelf seed, whose addresses are on today's shelf or carry an oracle. A Jupiter token is read on chain when it carries a tag a rule asks for or has a verdict; every other named address is read. 2066 mints were read; of the other named addresses: 1 not_a_token_mint (the note names reserves, markets, programs and authorities beside its mints).
stated.identity: Read on chain for every row by getMultipleAccounts, the slot in read.height: decimals, the token program, the Token-2022 extensions by name in the order the mint holds them, the mint and freeze authorities (null with reason 'none' where the account's option is empty), the permanent delegate (the extension's key; 'none' where the extension is absent or, on a classic SPL mint, where the program has none). Symbol and name from the mint's own tokenMetadata extension, else its Metaplex metadata account (read at its derived address in a second batch), else the listing: Jupiter's row or, for a token Jupiter does not list, the shelf fixture's symbol (read.symbolFrom 'listing', name null with 'no_metadata_on_chain').
stated.ids: The tracked list's id for a tracked stock, else the shelf fixture's, else solana:<the symbol the chain answers, lower case, + as plus, * as star, any other run of characters a dash>. Where two rows meet on one slug, each takes a dash and the first six characters of its address, lower case.
stated.rules: A rule's match is read by the builder (scripts/risk/assets/solana-list.ts, MATCH_KEYS), every key holding: jupiterTag, Jupiter carries the tag; minter, the mint authority read on chain; program, spl or token2022; nameEndsWith, the name the chain answers; listedIn, on today's shelf that way, or any or none. Rules apply in the table's order and a token's own verdict last (decidedBy). Rows per rule: xstocks 1321, ondo-global-markets 449, backpack-securities 74, prestocks 10, lst 147, jupiter-deprecated 1, on-todays-shelf 24; with a verdict of their own: 57.
stated.derived: For a token of a stock issuer's rule (xstocks, ondo-global-markets, backpack-securities) the builder derives two fields, the lowest layer: underlying, the symbol the chain answers less the issuer's suffix ('x' for xStocks, 'on' for Ondo; Backpack's symbol is the ticker), null with 'symbol_without_the_issuer_suffix' where the suffix is missing; and category, tokenized_stock, or the fund's category where the tracked list's class table (CLASS_BY_UNDERLYING in scripts/risk/universe/list.ts, DU7) names the underlying (SPY etf, QQQ etf, GLD gold, SLV commodity, USO commodity, SGOV dollar_yield). No other fund among the issuers' tokens is told apart, as no read gives a token's kind: an ETF outside that table is filed tokenized_stock (stated, not chosen).
stated.status: listed: on today's shelf, by mint in the structurer's registry (packages/engine/src/assets/registry.ts), as the model of a token of deployments/solana-devnet.json (its modelOf matched to the one named mint that answers that symbol), or a tracked stock of scripts/risk/universe/solana.json; listedIn says which. A tracked stock's row names its tracked row and reads its pools and oracle there. A stock token outside the cut is candidate, 'outside the 80% cut' (DA16, stated, not chosen). Dollar yield takes the research note's verdict: add and add with caution candidate, hold held_out, out held_out or excluded by its reason, verdictSource naming the note and section. Permissioned funds held_out (DA4); a token in another currency held_out (USD-ONLY, DA7); crypto candidate (DA6); a token with a maturity or with no class held_out; defunct, exploit-linked or not the asset it claims excluded.
stated.shelf: The structurer's kamino-usdc row names the USDC mint (its leg is a deposit made in USDC), so it lists USDC; Kamino's deposit token itself (kUSDC, B8V6…) is a row of its own with the research note's verdict.
stated.legTypes: Only for dollar yield, from the research note, and held to the engine's table (packages/engine/src/personal/leg-types.ts) by the shelf fixture's symbol: a row whose types differ stops the run. A token the note types as none of the four is null with its reason, never a guess.
stated.oracle: A Scope entry where fixtures/solana-vault/scope-indexes.json names the mint, else where a Kamino reserve of risk_lending_pools prices it with a one-entry Scope chain; else null, 'no_scope_entry'. A tracked stock's oracle is read in its tracked row. A Pyth feed the launch-shelf seed names is in unverifiedOracles and is never read (DU4).
stated.pools: How many pools of the registry file data/risk/registry-20261001T0139.json (pnpm risk:registry: pools confirmed on chain at build) hold the mint on either side, all counted as confirmed; none: null, 'no_registered_pool'. That registry was built for the stock tokens' pools, so a count there is the pools a token shares with a stock token, not every pool it has.
